questions.stem: The H.C.F. and L.C.M. of three expressions are \(6xz\) and \(108x^3y^2z^2\) respectively. The first two expressions are \(54x^3yz\) and \(18x^2y^2z\). Which is the third expression?

questions.solution: For A, the coefficient gcd is 6 and lcm is 108; minimum variable exponents give \(xz\) and maxima give \(x^3y^2z^2\). B has coefficient lcm 216; C leaves at least \(x^2\) in the H.C.F.; D leaves coefficient 18. Thus only A meets both conditions.
questions.solutionZh: 選 A 時，係數的最大公因數為 6、最小公倍數為 108；變量最低指數給 \(xz\)，最高指數給 \(x^3y^2z^2\)。B 的係數最小公倍數為 216；C 的最大公因式含 \(x^2\)；D 的公因數係數為 18，均不符。

Given \(P(x)=x^2-x-6\) and \[\begin{gathered}Q(x) =x^3 -4x^2 -3x \\ +18\end{gathered}\].
(a) Factorise \(P(x)\) and \(Q(x)\).

questions.stem:
(a) Write down the quotient and remainder when \(2x^3-x^2-6x-4\) is divided by \(2x^2-3x-9\).
(b) Let \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x^3-x^2-6x-4) \\ -(ax+b)\end{gathered}\], where \(a,b\) are constants. It is given that \(g(x)\) is divisible by \(2x^2-3x-9\).
(i) Write down \(a,b\).
(ii) Factorise \(g(x)\).
(iii) Let \(f(x)=x^3-7x-6\). Simplify \[\begin{gathered}\frac1{f(x)} \\ -\frac1{g(x)}\end{gathered}\].
questions.stemZh:
(a) 寫出 \(2x^3-x^2-6x-4\) 被 \(2x^2-3x-9\) 除的商及餘式。
(b) 設 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x^3-x^2-6x-4) \\ -(ax+b)\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(a,b\) 為常數。已知 \(g(x)\) 可被 \(2x^2-3x-9\) 整除。
(i) 寫出 \(a,b\)。
(ii) 把 \(g(x)\) 因式分解。
(iii) 設 \(f(x)=x^3-7x-6\)，化簡 \[\begin{gathered}\frac1{f(x)} \\ -\frac1{g(x)}\end{gathered}\]。
questions.solution:
(a) Long division gives quotient \(x+1\) and remainder \(6x+5\).
(b)(i) Subtract the entire remainder: \(a=6,b=5\).
(ii) \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x^2-3x-9)(x+1) \\ =(2x+3)(x-3)(x+1)\end{gathered}\].
(iii) \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+1)(x+2)(x-3)\end{gathered}\]. Taking a common denominator leaves numerator \((2x+3)-(x+2)=x+1\). Cancel this factor to obtain \(\frac1{(x-3)(x+2)(2x+3)}\).
The original expression requires \[\begin{gathered}x\ne -2, -\frac32, \\ -1,3\end{gathered}\]; cancellation does not restore \(x=-1\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 用長除法得商 \(x+1\)，餘式 \(6x+5\)。
(b)(i) 須減去整個餘式，故 \(a=6,b=5\)。
(ii) \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(2x^2-3x-9)(x+1) \\ =(2x+3)(x-3)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]。
(iii) \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+1)(x+2)(x-3)\end{gathered}\]。通分後分子為 \((2x+3)-(x+2)=x+1\)，約去後得 \(\frac1{(x-3)(x+2)(2x+3)}\)。
原式須滿足 \[\begin{gathered}x\ne -2, -\frac32, \\ -1,3\end{gathered}\]；約去因式不能恢復 \(x=-1\)。

questions.stem:
Let \(f(x)=4x^3-7x-3\).
(a) Show that \(2x+1\) is a factor of \(f(x)\).
(b) It is given that \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =f(x)\div(15-10x)\end{gathered}\].
(i) Express \(g(x)\) in terms of \(x\).
(ii) Hence find the minimum value of \(1-g(x)\).
questions.stemZh:
設 \(f(x)=4x^3-7x-3\)。
(a) 證明 \(2x+1\) 是 \(f(x)\) 的因式。
(b) 已知 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =f(x)\div(15-10x)\end{gathered}\]。
(i) 以 \(x\) 表示 \(g(x)\)。
(ii) 從而求 \(1-g(x)\) 的最小值。
questions.solution:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(-\frac12) = \\ -\frac12 +\frac72 \\ -3 =0\end{gathered}\], so the factor theorem applies.
(b)(i) Division and factorisation give \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x+1)(2x-3)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]. Since \(15-10x=-5(2x-3)\), \[\begin{gathered}g(x) = \\ -\frac15(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\], with \(x\ne\frac32\).
(ii) Complete the square: \[\begin{gathered}1 -g(x) \\ =\frac25(x+\frac34)^2 \\ +\frac{39}{40}\end{gathered}\]. Its minimum is \(\frac{39}{40}\), attained at \(x=-\frac34\), which is allowed.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(-\frac12) = \\ -\frac12 +\frac72 \\ -3 =0\end{gathered}\]，由因式定理得證。
(b)(i) 相除及分解得 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(2x+1)(2x-3)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]。由 \(15-10x=-5(2x-3)\)，得 \[\begin{gathered}g(x) = \\ -\frac15(2x+1)(x+1)\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(x\ne\frac32\)。

questions.stem:
A cubic polynomial \(f(x)\) has factor \(x+1\). When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x^2-1\), the remainder is \(4x+k\), where \(k\) is an integer.
(a) Find \(k\).
(b) When \(f(x)\) is divided by \(-x\), the remainder is \(-4\). Someone claims that \(f(x)=0\) cannot have repeated roots different from \(-1\). Is the claim correct? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
三次多項式 \(f(x)\) 有因式 \(x+1\)。\(f(x)\) 被 \(x^2-1\) 除的餘式為 \(4x+k\)，其中 \(k\) 為整數。
(a) 求 \(k\)。
(b) \(f(x)\) 被 \(-x\) 除的餘式為 \(-4\)。有人聲稱 \(f(x)=0\) 不可能有異於 \(-1\) 的重根。此說法正確嗎？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) Evaluate at \(-1\): \(0=-4+k\), so \(k=4\).
(b) Write \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x^2-1)(ax+b) \\ +4x +4\end{gathered}\], where \(a\ne0\) because the polynomial is cubic. Since \(f(0)=-4\), \(-b+4=-4\) gives \(b=8\).
Then \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+1)[ax^2+(8-a)x-4]\end{gathered}\]. The quadratic discriminant is \[\begin{gathered}(8-a)^2 +16a =a^2 \\ +64>0\end{gathered}\] for real \(a\), so its two roots are distinct. A repeated root could only arise when one coincides with the existing root \(-1\) (this happens at \(a=6\)). Thus no repeated root different from \(-1\) is possible; the claim is correct.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 代入 \(-1\) 得 \(0=-4+k\)，故 \(k=4\)。
(b) 寫成 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x^2-1)(ax+b) \\ +4x +4\end{gathered}\]；因為是三次式，所以 \(a\ne0\)。由 \(f(0)=-4\)，得 \(-b+4=-4\)，故 \(b=8\)。
於是 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) \\ =(x+1)[ax^2+(8-a)x-4]\end{gathered}\]。二次式的判別式為 \[\begin{gathered}(8-a)^2 +16a =a^2 \\ +64>0\end{gathered}\]，所以兩根相異。重根只可能來自其中一根與已有的 \(-1\) 重合（此時 \(a=6\)）。因此不可能有異於 \(-1\) 的重根，聲稱正確。

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=3x^3-4x+k\). If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-k\), find the remainder when \(f(x)\) is divided by \(x+k\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=3x^3-4x+k\)。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-k\) 整除，求它被 \(x+k\) 除的餘式。
questions.solution: From \(f(k)=0\), \(3k^3-3k=0\), hence \(k^3=k\). The required remainder is \[\begin{gathered}f(-k) = -3k^3 +5k \\ =2k\end{gathered}\]. This also holds when \(k=0\); do not divide by \(k\).
questions.solutionZh: 由 \(f(k)=0\) 得 \(3k^3-3k=0\)，故 \(k^3=k\)。所求餘式為 \[\begin{gathered}f(-k) = -3k^3 +5k \\ =2k\end{gathered}\]。\(k=0\) 時亦成立，不可直接除以 \(k\)。

(a) \[\begin{gathered}g(1) =1 +3 +r -4 -r \\ =0\end{gathered}\], so yes.
(b) Division gives \[\begin{gathered}g(x) \\ =(x-1)(x^2+4x+r)\end{gathered}\].
(c) Two possibilities exhaust exactly two distinct real roots. First the quadratic has a repeated root other than 1: \(16-4r=0\), giving \(r=4\) and roots \(1,-2\). Second it has two distinct roots, one equal to 1: \(1+4+r=0\), giving \(r=-5\) and \(g(x)=(x-1)^2(x+5)\).

For \(r>4\) only the root 1 is real; for \(r<4\) other than \(-5\) there are three distinct real roots. Thus precisely \(r=4,-5\) work; agree.

zh-Hant.text: (c) 恰有兩個相異實根有且只有兩種可能：二次式有異於 1 的重根，則 \(16-4r=0\)，得 \(r=4\)，根為 \(1,-2\)；或二次式有兩個相異實根且其中一根是 1，則 \(1+4+r=0\)，得 \(r=-5\)，此時 \(g(x)=(x-1)^2(x+5)\)。
若 \(r>4\)，只有實根 1；若 \(r<4\) 且 \(r\ne-5\)，有三個相異實根。因此恰有 \(r=4,-5\) 兩值可行，故同意。

questions.stem:
Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =x^3 -x^2 +ax \\ +b\end{gathered}\]. It is divisible by \(x-1\), and its remainder on division by \(x-2\) is \(-4\).
(a) Find \(a,b\).
(b) Solve \(f(x)+4=0\).
questions.stemZh:
設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =x^3 -x^2 +ax \\ +b\end{gathered}\]。它可被 \(x-1\) 整除，被 \(x-2\) 除的餘式為 \(-4\)。
(a) 求 \(a,b\)。
(b) 解 \(f(x)+4=0\)。
questions.solution:
(a) \(f(1)=0\) gives \(a+b=0\); \(f(2)=-4\) gives \(2a+b=-8\). Hence \(a=-8,b=8\).
(b) \[\begin{gathered}f(x) +4 =x^3 -x^2 \\ -8x +12 \\ =(x-2)(x^2+x-6) \\ =(x-2)^2(x+3)\end{gathered}\]. Thus \(x=2\) or \(x=-3\); 2 is a repeated root.

questions.stem:
A polynomial \(f(x)\) is divisible by \((x-1)(x-4)\). When it is divided by \((x-1)^2\), the quotient is \(g(x)\) and the remainder is \(3x+k\), where \(k\) is a constant.
(a) Find \(k\).
(b) A student claims that \(g(x)+1=0\) has at least one real root. Do you agree? Explain.
questions.stemZh:
多項式 \(f(x)\) 可被 \((x-1)(x-4)\) 整除。它被 \((x-1)^2\) 除的商為 \(g(x)\)，餘式為 \(3x+k\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。
(a) 求 \(k\)。
(b) 學生聲稱 \(g(x)+1=0\) 至少有一個實根。你同意嗎？解釋。
questions.solution:
(a) \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x-1)^2g(x) \\ +3x +k\end{gathered}\]. Since \(f(1)=0\), \(3+k=0\), so \(k=-3\).
(b) Since \(f(4)=0\), \(9g(4)+12-3=0\), giving \(g(4)=-1\). Hence \(x=4\) is a real root of \(g(x)+1=0\); agree.

questions.stem: Find the H.C.F. of \(4a^3-4a^2+a\) and \(16a^4-2a\).
questions.solution: Factor as \(a(2a-1)^2\) and \(2a(2a-1)(4a^2+2a+1)\). Their common factors at minimum powers give \(a(2a-1)\); the numerical coefficient gcd is 1.

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)=2x^3-ax+b\). It has factor \(x^2-4\). Find its remainder on division by \(x-1\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(f(x)=2x^3-ax+b\)，且 \(x^2-4\) 是它的因式。求它被 \(x-1\) 除的餘式。
questions.solution: Since \(f(2)=f(-2)=0\), \(16-2a+b=0\) and \(-16+2a+b=0\). Hence \(b=0,a=8\), and the required remainder is \(f(1)=2-8=-6\).

questions.stem: Let \(m\) be a constant such that \(3x^3+mx^2-2x+18\) is divisible by \(3x+m\). Find \(m\).
questions.solution: Write the polynomial as \(x^2(3x+m)-2x+18\). At \(x=-m/3\), divisibility gives \(2m/3+18=0\), hence \(m=-27\).

questions.stem: Let \(g(x)=ax^3-bx^2-2\), where \(a,b\) are constants. If \(x+3\) is a factor, find \(g(3)\).
questions.solution: As \[\begin{gathered}g(-3) = -27a -9b -2 \\ =0\end{gathered}\], \(-9b-2=27a\). Therefore \[\begin{gathered}g(3) =27a -9b -2 \\ =54a\end{gathered}\].
questions.solutionZh: 由 \[\begin{gathered}g(-3) = -27a -9b -2 \\ =0\end{gathered}\]，得 \(-9b-2=27a\)，所以 \[\begin{gathered}g(3) =27a -9b -2 \\ =54a\end{gathered}\]。

questions.stem: Let \(f(x)\) be a polynomial divisible by \(x-2\). Which must be a factor of \(f(3x+2)\)?

questions.solution: Let \(h(x)=f(3x+2)\). Since \(f(2)=0\), \(h(0)=0\). Therefore \(x\) is a factor of \(h(x)\).

questions.stem: Let \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x+3)(x^2-11) \\ +k\end{gathered}\], where \(k\) is a constant. If \(f(x)\) is divisible by \(x-3\), find its remainder on division by \(x+2\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \[\begin{gathered}f(x) =(x+3)(x^2-11) \\ +k\end{gathered}\]，其中 \(k\) 為常數。若 \(f(x)\) 可被 \(x-3\) 整除，求它被 \(x+2\) 除的餘式。
questions.solution: From \(f(3)=6(9-11)+k=0\), \(k=12\). The required remainder is \[\begin{gathered}f(-2) =1(4-11) +12 \\ =5\end{gathered}\].

questions.stem: Find the H.C.F. of \(x^2y^3z\), \(x^8y^3z^3\) and \(x^8y^6z^3\).
questions.solution: Take the minimum powers of each variable: \(x^2\), \(y^3\) and \(z\). Thus the H.C.F. is \(x^2y^3z\).

questions.stem: Let \(g(x)=3x^2-bx+10\), where \(b\) is a constant. Its remainder on division by \(x-2\) is 12. Find its remainder on division by \(3x-8\).
questions.stemZh: 設 \(g(x)=3x^2-bx+10\)，其中 \(b\) 為常數。它被 \(x-2\) 除的餘式為 12，求它被 \(3x-8\) 除的餘式。
questions.solution: Use \(g(2)=12\): \(12-2b+10=12\), hence \(b=5\). The required remainder is \[\begin{gathered}g(8/3) =64/3 -40/3 \\ +10 =18\end{gathered}\].
